context_for_next_testing_agent: Multitenancy Phase 1 fully validated. Key verifications: (1) Admin login returns company_id, company_name, company_slug, available_companies, (2) POST /api/companies creates new tenant and adds to admin's company_access_ids, (3) POST /api/companies/select switches active tenant and sets cookie, (4) GET /api/auth/me and GET /api/companies/current return switched company when X-Company-Id header sent, (5) Users created in new tenant have that tenant's company_id, (6) GET /api/users is isolated by tenant, (7) Tech login returns company context, (8) Session refresh preserves active tenant. Frontend: CompanySwitcher shows 11 companies, switching works with toast notification, tech portal shows company name in header.
features_tested: Admin login returns multicompany context (company_id, company_name, company_slug, available_companies)
Company switcher appears in frontend admin sidebar
Switching company updates session without breaking navigation
POST /api/companies creates new tenant and admin gets access
GET /api/auth/me and GET /api/companies/current return new company after switch
User created in new tenant has that tenant's company_id
GET /api/users is isolated by tenant (no user leakage)
Tech portal header shows active company
Session refresh preserves active tenant with X-Company-Id header
